controls: Double-tap E or its icon within450ms to toggle Saltwater Shiv autocast. Single tap keeps explicit target selection. Green outline and A mark enabled mode. Default off; retained through respawn, cleared on a new match.
behavior: Only a committed ordinary attack on a valid enemy hero can spend mana/start cooldown. Cancelled windups spend nothing; unavailable autocast falls back to ordinary attacks without failure notifications. Manual preparation is not charged twice; an automatic miss cannot arm a later attack.

on.environment: Actual native input and renderer on host; SDK timer/key/audio services modeled. Not a physical H1 screenshot.

off.environment: Actual native input and renderer on host; SDK timer/key/audio services modeled. Not a physical H1 screenshot.

device_update.reason: No H1Debug USB device detected; user reconnect request pending.

harness_notes: Initial host compile needed the existing damage API declaration. Enemy fixture AI taunted the caster; the isolated ordinary-attack fixture now uses an unlearned zero-mana target. Actual MIPS combat attaches the original vision provider and uses real position/status APIs rather than direct Game writes.
scope: Host actual rules/native UI/renderer, complete-BDA MIPS input and one real basic-attack autocast path; physical device and FPS not tested.
